name: March
focus: Women's Day + Main Character Month (format exploration)
objective: Hold the March trough: widen members' formats, use Women's Day for Bandra Lab acquisition, stop March expiries waiting for April, fix Bengaluru's second-visit leak.
strategy:
Main Character Month.

Commercial job: Hold the March trough: widen members' formats, use Women's Day for Bandra Lab acquisition, stop March expiries waiting for April, fix Bengaluru's second-visit leak.

Renewal: Monogamy Is Overrated (“Committed to one class? Cute. Members who play the field stay longer.”). One-format members renew 58–67% vs 85–87% for members on 4+ formats. Bonus classes cost little in off-peak slots and target the single biggest renewal predictor after attendance.

Renewal: Bura Na Mano, Renewal Hai (“Bura na mano, renewal hai. 48 hours only.”). In 2026 Kwality did ₹20.2L in March, then ₹50.0L in April at 20.4% discount depth — March renewals waited. A short, fun window with a 3M upgrade pulls them forward at ≤20% effective.
notes: Build: 55 new buyers × ₹11,150 first-60-day spend = ₹6.2L; 60 renewals × ₹23,384 = ₹14.1L; 27 winbacks = ₹3.1L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹2.3L. Offers carry ₹12.8L (50% of target); the rest is business-as-usual. Funnel uses measured rates (lead→trial 51% CRM status, trial→member 26.9%) — not invented lifts.

funnel.dataQuality: lead→trial = CRM 'Trial Completed' status (not attendance-verified); trial→member = trailing measured; see dataGaps

offers.name: Monogamy Is Overrated
offers.headline: Committed to one class? Cute. Members who play the field stay longer.
offers.benefit: For members who've used one format in the last 60 days. Pack members renew at list and get 2 bonus classes valid only in formats they've never tried (Mumbai: powerCycle / Strength Lab induction / Cardio Barre; Kenkere: Cardio Barre / Mat 57 / Foundations). Unlimited members renew at list and get +5 days if they take 3 different formats in their first 30 days.

offers.name: Lift Like a Girl
offers.headline: Women's Day isn't about flowers. It's about deadlifts.
offers.benefit: Supreme HQ only, Mon 8–Sun 14 Mar: women new to P57 get their first Strength Lab class free (normally needs the 2-for-1), in off-peak Lab slots. Book a second class before leaving and buy 1 Month or a 12-class pack within 72 hours: the standard 15% (₹17,203 / ₹16,735) plus a free Lab induction seat for a friend.

offers.objective: Use idle Lab capacity at Bandra to acquire new clients and test a strength-first journey.
offers.conditions: Standard 15% only. Max 6 free Lab seats per class.
offers.kpi: Lab first visits; Lab-first → purchase vs barre trial (target ≥25%).
